goal.text: The wearer is tidying the living room and the hall before moving on to the kitchen, and wants a running account of what he has already dealt with so he can confirm nothing has been left out of place.

turns.text: I'm tidying in here. What have I straightened so far?

trigger.detail: first pass of arranging objects on the low table finishes

expected_answer.text: You bent over the centre table and arranged the items on it with both hands, then shifted sideways and straightened the decorative plate.

turns.text: — and that one, both hands or just the left?

trigger.detail: the user cuts into the answer to pin down a detail of the last item mentioned

expected_answer.text: Both hands. You were still bent over when you squared it up, and you only straightened once you turned towards the sofa.

turns.text: Sorry, quick one — which way did I turn to end up facing this?

trigger.detail: the turn away from the table ends with the wearer stood in front of the sofa

expected_answer.text: You turned clockwise away from the table and ended up standing in front of the sofa, glancing right once before looking back at it.

turns.text: Anyway — reaching in here, what did I stop at?

trigger.detail: the wearer settles into leaning inside the hall cupboard

expected_answer.text: You stopped beside the cabinet in the corridor, held it with your right hand, and looked at the display sitting on top of it.

turns.text: — did I pass a mirror on the way out?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in with a check on something seen before leaving the other room

expected_answer.text: Yes. One came into view briefly while you were sliding the rug with your foot, just before you walked off toward the corridor.

turns.text: Mm-hm... mm — actually, how long was that in shot for?

trigger.detail: an acknowledgement that turns into a follow-up question

expected_answer.text: Only about a second and a half, in a single glimpse. It never came back into view after that.

turns.text: These cushions — what did I do with the bag?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the light fitting for the doorway while the wearer settles on the sofa

expected_answer.text: You put it straight down on the floor with your right hand as you sat, before you started moving the cushions around.

turns.text: Oh — by the way, when did I pass that laundry?

trigger.detail: the shift opens a question about an object outside current attention

expected_answer.text: The washer-dryer? You caught it for only half a second in the corridor, about eight seconds before you sat down.

turns.text: — right, and what have I been doing with this cushion since I picked it up?

trigger.detail: the user cuts back to the activity in his lap

expected_answer.text: Turning it anticlockwise over and over with both hands, with the occasional flip in between. You still have not put it down.

turns.text: And the cushion — when did that stop?

trigger.detail: a long unbroken stretch of the same seated activity

expected_answer.text: You dropped it back onto the seat at about the two-minute mark, then leaned forward and picked up a magazine instead.

turns.text: Um, hang on — have I turned a page at all?

trigger.detail: the user doubts his own account of what he has been doing

expected_answer.text: You have been turning pages steadily, mostly with your right hand, and talking to your colleague at the same time.

turns.text: — who was I pointing at, back in the hall?

trigger.detail: mention of the colleague pulls the user back to an earlier moment

expected_answer.text: You stopped in the corridor, turned anticlockwise to look at one colleague, and pointed at the other with your right index finger.

turns.text: How long have I been sat here with this open?

trigger.detail: the reading has run on well past a minute

expected_answer.text: About eighty seconds so far. You had already been on the sofa for roughly fifty seconds before you opened it.

turns.text: Speaking of which, which hand have I been using?

expected_answer.text: Mostly your right, but you have just switched over and started using your left hand on the pages.

turns.text: — is that the first time I've swapped over?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in to check whether the change is new

expected_answer.text: It is. Everything before this point was done with the other hand, from the moment you first opened it on your lap.

turns.text: Right — that's me done with it?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the doorway for the light fitting as the reading ends

expected_answer.text: Yes, you have just set it down on the seat beside you and rested both hands on your lap.

turns.text: — and where did that end up?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in for the resting place of the item he just released

expected_answer.text: On the sofa beside you, roughly where you had put the cushion down before you picked it up.

turns.text: — and now I'm on my feet, what was I doing with my arms just then?

trigger.detail: the wearer stands and starts moving in the room again

expected_answer.text: Raising them alternately as you stood and walked, then stretching both arms out and stamping your right foot once.

turns.text: Okay — back to where we started. Am I done in there, or did I leave something out of place?

trigger.detail: the wearer arrives in the kitchen and stops in front of the fridge

expected_answer.text: Nothing is left out: both cushions are back on the seat, the magazine is beside them, the bag is down by your feet, and you shut the cupboard in the hall behind you.
